data.name: Settings_Tip_SyncHandShapeToChord
data.value: Re-fingering or reshaping a chord also moves the hand shape drawn over it onto the new shape. A chord and its bar are one decision, and a fingering edit mints a private chord shape — so with this off the bar keeps describing the shape that used to be there, which is what the game draws its fingers from. On by default.

data.name: Settings_Tip_SyncAnchorToFingering
data.value: After a fingering edit, move the fret-hand position onto the fret the index finger is authored on. Rocksmith derives the playing finger from the hand position, so a disagreement shows the player a different fingering than the chart states. Off by default — unlike a hand shape, a hand position is usually shared with neighboring notes this edit never touched, so moving it can silently re-finger them. The inspector reports the disagreement (E04) either way.

data.value: Asks the AI provider from Settings ▸ AI to correct only the fret-hand positions, on the selection or the whole arrangement. The model is never asked about fingers: chord fingerings the app suggested follow the new anchors automatically, and a charter's own fingering is kept (a reply that contradicts it is rejected).
